intro.text: An officer in Duchess Khrissalla's escort on her voyage to Dayside, who flouts orders to keep his pistol hidden.
An officer in Duchess Khrissalla's escort who shoots the party's guide and then deserts with Private Torth.
An Elisian noble and officer in Duchess Khrissalla's escort who shoots the party's guide and deserts.

items.text: When Baon rebuked him for showing his pistol, Flennid argued that Daysiders would not know a gun if they saw one, then sulkily obeyed. At Dosha-Har'Ken he went with Khriss to find supplies and saw the A'kar preaching in the market.
On the Kerla he glared at the armed Kerztians they passed and told Torth to watch them; Khriss thought he was itching for a fight.

Riding ahead with Torth to the Diem's tents, he found the slain sand masters. When Daazk fled shouting, Flennid took it for a call to ambush and shot him. Baon took his gun, and soon afterwards he and Torth slipped away toward the port with the tonk carrying the water and food.

appearance.text: Wears a military tricorne and a maroon officer's jacket trimmed with gold, khaki trousers and brown calf-high boots.
